messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error message - match.names
parts:
Please investigate whether you can process a subset of the data, and try to figure out whether the problem is caused by one specific file or not.
For this you may want to set overwrite = FALSE and specific specific file range (with f0 and f1). This to avoid having to reprocess all the data. 
Vincent

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Error message - match.names
parts:
Hi Susana,
I have looked into the files you sent me and discovered the problem.
Due to changes earlier this year GGIR is not able anymore to process more than one non-angle metric.
I have now fixed that in the GitHub branch "issue247_1to6bug" in case you are familiar with GitHub.
If not, then do not worry, this will be included in the next release of GGIR. After that you will be able to work with multiple non-angle metrics again.

In the meantime, you should be able to process your files by turning off the addition metrics, e.g. do.en = FALSE.
Best, Vincent

And what if you do the following?

In R console:
Type: install.packages("devtools", depencies = TRUE)
Press Enter
Type: library(devtools)
Press Enter 
Type: install_github("wadpac/GGIR")

This should install the latest development version of GGIR.
You may need to restart R. Also (for the purpose of testing) I would recommend starting in a fresh output folder.

Vincent
